text:
sam (CEO): short live follow-up from today's Q&A: please list one concrete reason a deal was won or lost this month and one immediate action (<=2 weeks). keep it tight.

luke (All-hands host): dropping the thread. paste anonymized lines.

maya (VP Sales): loss: international medtech wanted on-prem test package and faster compliance review; we had no ready quickstart. action: deliver an on-prem quickstart checklist + estimated delivery timelines.

alice (Customer Success): win: templated prompts + onboarding playbook got a legaltech customer to prod in 3 days. action: CS to publish the onboarding template as a shared artifact.

jorge (Product): pattern: heavy ask for enterprise auth (SCIM, SSO mapping). action: product to publish an IdP compatibility note and sample mapping next week.

ravi (Eng): root cause for some timeouts: KV cache pressure with long-seqlen inputs under burst. action: add routing guardrail to prefer lower-seqlen variant for bursty customers and emit metric.

tanya (Solutions): lost demo: couldn't show controlled fallback during hallucination case. action: build a 5-min demo script + a short hallucination-handling slide for SEs.

elena (RevOps): ops ask: please add anonymized "loss_reason" lines to the shared drive and pick a standardized Salesforce "why_lost" value. i'll push a picklist update.

ops-bot: reminder: follow-up doc created: https://internal/docs/allhands/debriefs. add notes.

sam (CEO): agree with pragmatic docs first. if anyone needs quick resources, DM me.

luke (All-hands host): i'll collate these into a checklist with owners and due dates and ping in 2 weeks. thanks everyone!
file_notes: All-hands Q&A follow-up focusing on customer wins/losses and concrete short-term actions. Single continuous thread string; no title field per agents.md.
